page.overview:
Who is Apep?

Apep is a minor, non-playable character in Mortal Kombat: Deception.

Apep can be seen in the beginning of Deceptions Konquest Mode. He is Shujinko's guide and one of Bo' Rai Cho's students who also gives you several hints.

He is not seen again after you clear the village portion of Konquest.
